'''Sor-Nak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Alor-Wan]] had a vision about a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who would destroy the Voss way of life, Sor-Nak confronted [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] upon their arrival onto the [[Voss Orbital Docking Station]], but the vision prevented him from using force to dissuade the Sith. As Kallig was preparing to depart Voss with a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] traveler, [[Hadrik]], Sor-Nak again tried to stop them, as no Gormak was allowed to ever leave Voss.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sor-Nak appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Voss.
